home.title: Summarize YouTube Videos with AI
home.intro: Paste any YouTube link and get a structured summary in seconds — then chat with the video to jump to the moments that matter. Works even on videos without captions, where most summarizers give up.
home.benefitHeading: Why Choose Our AI Video Analysis
home.extractBody: Extract core insights from lengthy videos in minutes, not hours. Our AI distills hours of content into concise, actionable summaries.
home.askTranscriptBody: After the summary, ask follow-up questions and let the AI pull the answer straight from the transcript. Drill into a specific moment without scrubbing the timeline.
home.deepBody: Our advanced AI doesn't just transcribe—it analyzes context, identifies key arguments, and structures information for maximum comprehension.
home.withoutCaptionsBody: Most YouTube summarizers fail when a video has no transcript. We don't. When captions aren't available, we transcribe the audio with Whisper and summarize anyway — so caption-less talks, livestreams, and indie creators just work.
home.workflowBody: Transform how you consume video content with AI-powered efficiency tools
home.timeBody: Process 10x more content in the same amount of time with smart summarization
home.libraryBody: Sign in and every summary is saved to your dashboard, ready to revisit, re-chat, or share later
home.studyBody: Turn a 90-minute lecture into a structured outline, then ask the AI to clarify a specific concept or pull every formula it cited. Saves rewatching just to find the one minute that mattered.
home.workBody: Get the key takeaways from a 2-hour interview podcast in 60 seconds, then chat with the transcript to drill into the part that actually applies to your work. 18 summary languages, any public video — captions optional.
home.creator: Creator Research
home.creatorBody: Pull the structure out of a long-form video in your niche — hooks, talking points, supporting examples — without rewatching. Then chat with the transcript to extract specific quotes, references, or arguments you want to riff on for your own content.
home.dailyBody: Make informed decisions about which videos deserve your full attention. Get the essence of product reviews, documentaries, and tutorials before committing your time.

faqItems.question: What makes YouTube AI Chat unique?
faqItems.answer: Two things most competitors miss. First, we work on videos without captions: when YouTube has no transcript, we transcribe the audio with Whisper and summarize anyway, instead of failing. Second, every summary comes with a chat tab — ask follow-up questions and get answers pulled straight from the full transcript, so you can drill into a specific moment without rewatching.

faqItems.question: Does our tool support multiple languages for video analysis?
faqItems.answer: Yes. We can transcribe videos in any language YouTube captions or Whisper covers, and you can pick the summary output from 18 supported languages — including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, and more. A Japanese podcast can produce an English summary, or a Spanish keynote a Mandarin one.

faqItems.question: How does our AI handle technical or specialized content?
faqItems.answer: Summaries and chat are powered by Anthropic's Claude — a frontier LLM that handles specialized terminology across academic, technical, business, and creative domains. We don't strip out jargon: we work straight from the full transcript, so technical talks, research lectures, and code-heavy tutorials keep their nuance instead of getting flattened.

faqItems.question: Can I ask follow-up questions about a video?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Every summary has a Chat tab where you can ask anything and get an answer pulled straight from the transcript — clarify a concept, find a specific moment, or compare what two speakers said. Suggested follow-up prompts surface as you go so you can dig deeper without having to know what to ask.

faqItems.question: What's included in the Free Plan and Pro Plan?
faqItems.answer: Try one Video without signing up. The Free Plan includes 10 summaries per month, 5 Video Chat messages per Video, and a 10-item History. The Pro Plan includes unlimited summaries, Video Chat, and History for $6.99 per month, or a $4.99 per month equivalent billed as $59.88 annually. No credit card is required for the Free Plan.

faqItems.question: Are my summaries saved?
faqItems.answer: If you're signed in, yes — every summary lands in your dashboard with the full transcript, the AI summary, and any chat history you had with it. You can revisit, re-chat, or share a direct link to any past result.

steps.title: Drop Your Video Link
steps.body: Paste the URL of any public YouTube video — short clips, two-hour podcasts, lectures, keynotes. Length and topic don't matter.

steps.title: Hit Summarize
steps.body: One click, no settings to tune. Pick the output language if you want something other than English; otherwise we use a sensible default for your locale.

steps.title: We Pull the Transcript
steps.body: We grab YouTube's captions when they're available — that's the fast path. When the creator hasn't published captions, we fall back to downloading the audio and transcribing it with Whisper. Most summarizers fail on caption-less videos; we don't.

steps.title: Get Your Summary
steps.body: A structured breakdown with key points, themes, and clickable timestamps that jump the player to the moment cited. Copy any passage, save it to your dashboard, or share a link.

steps.title: Ask Follow-Up Questions
steps.body: Switch to the Chat tab and ask anything. Claude answers from the full transcript, with suggested follow-up prompts so you can dig deeper without re-watching.
